name: brickhubremote
description: Drive a programmable robot hub from the browser over Web Bluetooth.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node tests/test_proto.js && node tests/test_cards.js && node tests/test_ldraw.js && node tests/test_topython.js && python3 -I tests/test_hub_program.py && python3 -I tools/lqa.py check && python3 -I tests/test_lqa.py
scripts.test:browser: node tests/test_page.js && node tests/test_fold.js && node tests/test_sw.js && node tests/test_landing.js
scripts.vendor:blockly: cp node_modules/blockly/blockly_compressed.js vendor/blockly/ && for m in nl en de fr it es pt-br pl zh-hans ja; do cp node_modules/blockly/msg/$m.js vendor/blockly/msg-$m.js; done && cp node_modules/blockly/media/* site/app/blockly-media/ && cp node_modules/blockly/LICENSE licenses/Apache-2.0-Blockly.txt
